claim_boundaries.descriptive_extrema_only: Sign counts and extrema are exact descriptions, not tolerances, quality scores, camera rankings, representation rankings or fixture decisions.
claim_boundaries.frozen_representation_sensitivity_only: This report compares deterministic representations inside the pinned Turn2848 package and adds no independent observation, model request, robot episode, image, label or scientific sample.
claim_boundaries.not_human_centroids: Projected point centers and projected AABB-envelope centers are not object-pixel measurements, masks or human image centroids.
claim_boundaries.science_and_dispatch: No A1-A9 result, measurement qualification, stage advance, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_confounding: All three pairs are availability-selected; D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership.

finding: Across three availability-selected original/reflected mapping pairs, nine world-object rows yield 27 exact center-versus-AABB-midpoint residual differences and 36 camera-object rows yield 72 projected point-center-versus-AABB-envelope-center residual differences. The largest absolute world component difference is +0.31600892543792725 mm on D02 cube x; the largest projected component difference is +0.5471362857456938 px on D02 cube wrist v. These representation-sensitivity descriptions do not validate an image centroid, estimate an effect or advance any scientific gate.

representation_semantics.projected: Project the retained actual object center and constructed reflected center point through the unchanged frozen camera configuration, form their residual, then subtract the frozen projected AABB-envelope-center residual. The independent identity compares point-minus-envelope-center offsets in the actual and constructed representations.
representation_semantics.proxy_boundary: Retained object centers, AABB midpoints, projected center points and projected AABB-envelope centers are geometric representations. Neither projected representation is an observed or human-labeled image centroid, and this diagnostic does not decide which representation is preferable.
representation_semantics.signs_and_units: World signs follow robot-base x/y/z and are stored in metres with exact 1000x millimetre copies. Projected signs follow stored u/v pixel coordinates. Zero means exact float equality; no epsilon, threshold, normalization, fitting or registration is applied.
representation_semantics.world: Subtract the frozen actual-minus-constructed AABB-midpoint residual from the frozen actual-minus-constructed retained object-center residual. The independent identity is the reflected-arm center-minus-AABB-midpoint offset minus the constructed-reference equivalent.
